item.title: It Seems That the Rainbow Mafia Overreached
item.description: Two research psychologists try to explain why, politically, both the Left and the Right are increasingly turning against homosexual behavior and culture.

item.title: Trump Shifts to the Economy
item.description: Continuing his Affordability Tour, Donald Trump is still refining the message on his administration's efforts to lift the economic boat for all Americans.

item.title: Wednesday Executive News Summary
item.description: Trump sticking with Noem, Omar sprayed with unknown substance, Schumer wants another shutdown, reviewing the DC air crash, and more.

item.title: Anti-ICE Doxing Network Exposed
item.description: An investigative journalist infiltrated an anti-ICE network's Signal chats and exposed the names of several potentially prominent people involved.

item.title: DHS: Get the ICE Mission and Optics Right
item.description: DHS has focused its ICE efforts on deporting the "worst of the worst," but it has failed to make that clear.

item.title: Thursday Short Cuts
item.description: Notable quotables from Tim Walz, Mark Alexander, Jacob Frey, Ana Navarro, Rick Wilson, Tiffany Cross, Steve Kerr, Jimmy Failla, and more.

item.title: The Risks and Reality Check for Anti-ICE Protesters
item.description: If you're ever tempted to wade into a volatile situation, remember Alex Pretti's story and choose the smarter, safer path.

item.title: Alex Pretti's Death Must Be Understood Separately From Renee Good's
item.description: Both were doing things in places that they should have been, but Good presented far more of a threat than Pretti.

item.title: Virginia Dems' Redistricting Gambit Thwarted
item.description: A district judge blocked Virginia Democrats' gerrymandering efforts in a big blow for the folks trying to make Old Dominion a single-party state.

item.title: Fake Google Review Extortion Scam Targets Small Businesses
item.description: It's a tactic that's reminiscent of the mob: Nice business you've got there; shame if anything happened to it.
